edits.name: Building Effective Human-Agent Teams
edits.value: Short course on moving a team from using AI one person at a time to working alongside a shared agent: clear roles, gradual release, and what the agent can see. No technical background needed.

edits.name: Building Effective Human-Agent Teams
edits.value: I'd put this in front of any team lead whose organisation already uses AI and is starting to hand work to an agent. It's short, and it's about roles and access rather than the tool. It's in beta, so expect it to change. If your team is newer to AI, do the Nonprofit Track first.

edits.name: WebAIM Contrast Checker
edits.value: Enter a text colour and a background colour and it gives the contrast ratio, with a pass or fail against WCAG AA and AAA for normal text, large text and interface components. Free, no account. From WebAIM, a non-profit at Utah State University.

edits.name: WebAIM Contrast Checker
edits.value: When you're checking one colour pair, a button on a brand colour or text over an image, and want a result you can quote. Each check has a permalink you can send to a designer or supplier.

edits.name: WebAIM Contrast Checker
edits.value: WebAIM is a long-standing accessibility non-profit, so a result from its checker carries weight with a designer or supplier. It checks one pair at a time; for a whole palette, Delphitools is quicker.
